voice_description: Native Japanese, standard Japanese. A middle-aged male religious leader in a dramatic fantasy anime. Controlled, dignified and quietly intimidating. He speaks with unwavering conviction and concise authority, and rarely raises his voice. Natural character dialogue rather than an announcer performance. Studio-quality recording.
text:
我が娘よ、神がお待ちだ。
どけ。

クロード……来なさい。
